text:
Cam (Design): Noticed a weird UX edge: when many toasts queue (bulk saves + syncs) they stack and the newest lands on top. This leads to older toasts being inaccessible by keyboard because tab order goes top-to-bottom. Screenshot + short vid attached.
Jules (Frontend): Repro: trigger 4 quick saves -> toasts animate in bottom-left stacked newest-on-top -> pressing Tab focuses the top toast action only. Also the visual stack uses -8px overlap which clips the focus ring on stacked items.
Rina (a11y): Two accessibility problems: 1) Keyboard navigation should follow DOM order to match focus order; if newest is inserted at the top, tabbing becomes surprising. 2) Screen readers read role=status regions in DOM order; we should ensure priority by aria-live politeness/importance, not DOM insertion order.
Harper (Product): Product ask: keep newest visible on top visually (so users see latest), but ensure keyboard users can reach older toasts and SRs get useful ordering. Also standardize copy: short noun-first toasts ("Backup started", "Backup failed").
Finn (SRE): Implementation constraints: stacking uses CSS transform translateY negative to overlap and we use absolute positioning. Changing DOM insertion order might break animation queues in the current lib. Suggest a minimal change: keep visual stacking newest-on-top but render toasts in DOM oldest-to-newest and use z-index to put newest on top. That preserves keyboard order.
Jules (Frontend): Good idea. Plan: 1) always append new toasts to the end of the toast container (DOM oldest->newest), 2) compute zIndex = base + index so newest gets highest z, 3) adjust overlap token from -8px to -6px and add clip-padding token to allow focus ring visible: `token.toast.stackOverlap = -6px`, `token.toast.stackClipPad = 6px`. CSS snippet: 
```
.toast { position: relative; margin-top: -6px; padding: 12px; }
.toast:focus { outline-offset: 6px; }
.container > .toast:nth-child(n){ z-index: calc(var(--base-z)+var(--i)); }
```
Rina (a11y): For SR ordering, keep `role=status` on each toast but set `aria-live` per severity (`polite` for success/info, `assertive` for errors). Also add `aria-atomic=true` so screen readers read the full message. For keyboard navigation to older toasts, ensure each toast action is tabbable and we don't trap focus in the topmost. Suggest aria-describedby hook from focused element to specific toast if we want to announce relation.
Cam (Design): Copy: standardize microcopy keys: `toast.[action].[state]` e.g., `toast.backup.started`, `toast.backup.completed`, `toast.backup.failed`. Keep messages under 30 chars where possible. For action buttons in toast use explicit labels: `Undo backup`, `View details`.
Harper (Product): Also a UX ask: add a small affordance to expand stacked toasts into a compact list on hover/focus so power users can scan recent messages. Maybe a vertical chevron that toggles expanded view. Keep it collapsed by default.
Jules (Frontend): We can add a11y-friendly expand toggle: `<button aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-controls=\"toast-list\">More</button>` which when toggled sets `aria-hidden=false` on older toasts so SR can access them. Implementation risk: ensure animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Finn (SRE): One more constraint: toasts are emitted from many services; we need unique ids across instances. Use `toast-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6)}`. Also telemetry: add `toast.stack.expand` and `toast.action.click` events.
Rina (a11y): Final nits: 1) when toast contains a link that opens a new route, ensure focus doesn't auto-shift unexpectedly; keep focus on the triggering element unless it's an error that requires action. 2) For errors that need immediate attention, move focus to a persistent banner and make the toast link to it.
Cam (Design): I'll update token doc + Figma frames with new stackOverlap and clipPad tokens and upload in #design-assets. Mock for expand control incoming.
notifier-bot: PR opened: frontend#2820 - \"toasts: stack order + z-index + a11y + tokens\"
Jules (Frontend): I'll implement the DOM append + z-index strategy, add new tokens, and wire aria-live by severity. Adding Cypress e2e: produce 5 toasts quickly and test tab order focuses actions oldest->newest. Tagging @Rina for review. ETA: tomorrow afternoon. :shipit:
